name: strain
definition: The fractional change in length a passing gravitational wave makes, ΔL/L. The loudest signals seen so far reach about 10⁻²¹.

name: frequency
definition: How many times per second something oscillates.

name: damping time
definition: The time an oscillation takes for its amplitude to fall by a factor e ≈ 2.72.

name: quality factor
definition: How long a ring lasts, counted in oscillations: Q = π f τ. A large Q rings for many cycles.

name: solar mass
definition: The mass of the Sun, about 1.99 × 10³⁰ kg. In the units of general relativity it is also a length, G M☉/c² ≈ 1.48 km, and a time, G M☉/c³ ≈ 4.93 μs.

name: mass
definition: Here, the mass of a black hole, usually in solar masses. Its ring's frequency scales as 1/M: a heavier black hole rings lower.

name: dimensionless spin
definition: How fast a black hole rotates, χ = cJ/(GM²) for angular momentum J. Zero for a black hole that does not rotate; always below 1.

name: horizon area
definition: The area of a black hole's event horizon, A = 8π (GM/c²)² (1 + √(1 − χ²)). Hawking's area theorem says the total can only grow.

name: redshift
definition: How much the expansion of the universe has stretched a signal on its way. Times and masses read in the detector are larger than at the source by a factor 1 + z.

name: quasinormal mode
definition: One tone of a ringing black hole: a frequency and a damping time, both fixed by the mass and spin. Labelled (ℓ, m, n); n = 0 is the fundamental and n ≥ 1 are overtones, which fade faster.

name: sampling rate
definition: How many samples of a signal are recorded per second. Frequencies above half the sampling rate, the Nyquist frequency, cannot be told apart from lower ones (aliasing).

name: power spectral density
definition: How much noise power the detector has at each frequency. Its square root, the amplitude spectral density, is the curve usually plotted.

name: signal-to-noise ratio
definition: How far a signal stands above the noise, measured in units of the noise's typical size after filtering with the expected shape.

name: likelihood
definition: How probable the data d would be if the parameters were θ. Read as a function of θ with d fixed.

name: prior
definition: What was believed about the parameters θ before looking at these data.

name: posterior
definition: What is believed about the parameters θ after the data d: prior times likelihood, normalised. In practice, a large set of samples.

name: credible interval
definition: A range that holds a stated share of the posterior, often 90%. It describes belief given the model, prior and data, not a guarantee.

name: evidence
definition: The probability of the data under a whole model, averaged over its prior. Comparing two models uses the difference ln Z₁ − ln Z₀, the log Bayes factor.

name: standard deviation
definition: The typical spread of a quantity around its mean. “nσ” quotes a result's distance from a reference in these units; it assumes independent, bell-shaped errors.

name: correlation coefficient
definition: A number from −1 to 1 for how closely two quantities move together. It describes a pattern; on its own it is not a cause or a law.
